signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: All rights and licenses granted to you terminate immediately; you must cease all use of the Services and remove the webability widget from your site.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: this space, and after trying Webability with once code, we are ending up buying 3 codes and hope they came up with an "unlimited" websites/domains plan in the future
A separate license must be purchased for each domain (or sub-domain) where you use the webability widget.
WebAbility may adjust License Fees for Customer Websites exceeding 100,000 monthly visits.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The cheapest tier is a usable slice of the product.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Not checked: domain records were unavailable.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $59 vs a stated $240 regular price (75% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can change terms and continued use means you accept the new terms.

quote.text: We may change these Terms; continued use after a change takes effect means you accept it.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can modify or discontinue any part of the service without notice.

quote.text: We reserve the right to modify, correct, enhance, improve, or discontinue any part of the Service without notice.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can push code changes to client sites without prior notice.

quote.text: WebAbility App has the right to update, tweak, or change the code of the Software, widget, and plugin and deploy all these changes publicly on all client websites without prior notice to users.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can terminate for any reason on 30 days notice, or immediately if required by law.

quote.text: We may terminate these Terms or any license at any time for any reason with 30 days’ prior written notice, except if required by law or unable to continue, in which case termination is immediate.

finePrint.summary: Vendor can suspend access for security risk, harm, breach or legal violation.

quote.text: WebAbility may suspend your access if we reasonably believe you pose a security risk, are causing harm to the Service or to others, or are in breach of these Terms or the law.

finePrint.summary: On termination buyer must stop using the service and remove the widget.

quote.text: All rights and licenses granted to you terminate immediately; you must cease all use of the Services and remove the webability widget from your site.

finePrint.summary: Prepaid unused fees are only refunded in the specific cases listed in Section 13.

quote.text: Either party can terminate. Prepaid fees for the unused period are refunded in the cases set out in Section 13.

finePrint.summary: If material adverse service changes occur buyer can terminate for a prorated refund.

quote.text: If we make material changes that materially and adversely affect your use, you may terminate your subscription and receive a prorated refund of any pre-paid fees for the remaining period.

finePrint.summary: Vendor termination for convenience includes a refund of prepaid fees for the remainder.

quote.text: You will receive a refund of any prepaid fees for the remainder of the period.

finePrint.summary: Each domain or subdomain requires its own separate paid license.

quote.text: A separate license must be purchased for each domain (or sub-domain) where you use the webability widget.

finePrint.summary: Sites over 100,000 monthly visits may face higher license fees.

quote.text: WebAbility may adjust License Fees for Customer Websites exceeding 100,000 monthly visits.

finePrint.summary: Paid PDF tier is capped at 200 credits per month up to 2,000 pages.

quote.text: 200 credits per month, up to 2,000 pages (1 credit per 10 pages, minimum 1 credit per document)

finePrint.summary: Vendor gives no legal advice and does not guarantee compliance with accessibility standards.

quote.text: We do not give legal advice and do not guarantee compliance with WCAG, ADA, Section 508, or any other standard.

finePrint.summary: Complaint support is limited to two complaints per website per year.

quote.text: Complaint Response Support covers up to two (2) Complaints per website per subscription year.

finePrint.summary: Trials are provided as-is without warranty or liability.

quote.text: Trials are provided “as-is,” without warranty or liability to the fullest extent permitted by law.

finePrint.summary: Normal Automated plan is $12/month for monitoring, fixes and online support.

quote.text: $12/month Basic monitoring & automated fixes Our basic plan for automation-only monitoring, fixes, and online support

finePrint.summary: Normal PDF remediation paid tier is $49/month with monthly credit and page limits.

quote.text: $49/month 200 credits per month, up to 2,000 pages (1 credit per 10 pages, minimum 1 credit per document)

themes.summary: Several buyers say support is fast, patient and knowledgeable, often praising founder Sid/Sidharth directly.

hits.quote: he was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and responsive.
They have excellent customer service as well, that was very patient and responsive.
He's been more than helpful with my questions and concerns.
Sidharth promptly responded to my inquiry and provided a detailed explanation with screenshots.

themes.summary: Many buyers say setup is super easy and the widget quickly improves accessibility and audit scores.

hits.quote: Super-easy to setup and start using it.
Took more time to register than add it to Wordpress.
it was incredibly easy, took me less than 10 minutes, and I’m not a techie by any stretch.
I have a 100 out of 100 Accessibility score on every page of my website as per google page speed insights!

themes.summary: Several buyers say the lifetime deal is great value and pays for itself with client work.

hits.quote: charged one client $750 for 3 years of ADA compliance service upfront.
Strong value for the lifetime deal price.
I feel the product is good value for money.

themes.summary: Some otherwise happy buyers note weak help docs and want clearer fix guidance, bulk exports and template-level handling.
